title: ClearValuesResponse
description: The response when clearing a range of values in a spreadsheet.

spreadsheetId.description: The spreadsheet the updates were applied to.

clearedRange.description: The range (in A1 notation) that was cleared. (If the request was for an unbounded range or a range larger than the bounds of the sheet, this will be the actual range that was cleared, bounded to the sheet's limits.)
